sectionTitle: Used or Reconditioned - Which Should You Buy?

options.description: Removed from a donor vehicle, tested, and sold with recorded mileage. The cost-effective route where donor supply is strong - every used unit states its own warranty term before you buy.
Fully stripped, machined and rebuilt with new wear parts, then tested before dispatch. Carries a 12-month, unlimited-mileage warranty - the right choice for maximum service life.
